title: Trigger dispatch message
description: The published wrapper on the trigger-instance dispatch exchange. It is not the stored trigger instance: the consumer creates that record before it acknowledges this message.

trigger.description: Which trigger fired, as the pack.name reference the dispatcher documents, or as an object. No discriminator separates the two forms.

payload.description: The event, in whatever shape the trigger type declares. The platform validates that it is a mapping and nothing else.

trace-context.description: Correlation token, or null when the sender has none — the consumer then mints one from the trigger instance it creates. Wire key: trace_context.
